argument: Thirteen plates must read as one unstable self-observation apparatus before they read as a decorative accordion. The off-axis stack, paper field, unequal overlaps, and internal cuts must carry the composition without interface chrome.

With labels, readout, controls, hint, and prose hidden, the first view must leave v038's sentence, v039's volume, and v040's mask. It should read as a local rewriting machine, not a grid, poster, face, or generic card stack.

The visitor must sustain attention on one shutter. A brief pointer/touch press, a miss, or a focus change must remain geometry-neutral; pointer, touch, keyboard, and the watch control must offer equivalent meaningful paths.
The watched shutter must gain actual DOM segment structure and change its own position, scale, fold, angle, and offset. Colour, status, timer, and prose cannot substitute for local geometry.

The answer must stay at the shutter that was watched. It must not be a remote response, cursor trail, global camera move, or selected-site halo. The new segment and refold must remain visible after attention ends.

A dwell just under the threshold must refuse without geometry change; a longer dwell must produce a stronger local edit. If all accepted watches look identical, duration is metadata rather than material.
Four local folds must compound in one field. Delete must reconstruct the exact preceding DOM state and release must restore the deterministic quiet seed.
Semantic DOM buttons, CSS clip geometry, CSS variables, and nested segment elements are the medium. No screenshot, imported type specimen, external font, or canvas fallback may carry the work.

little-critters is translated from situated agents and reciprocal attention into local memory of sustained observation. Animals, eyes, head-turning, characters, paper scene, source palette, source composition, source code, examples, and API surface are refused.

v041 changes representation, composition, encounter, temporal behaviour, medium, and viewer task: the mask, volume, and sentence become a semantic DOM shutter field in which duration edits the watched object locally rather than routing an answer elsewhere.

Delete v041 if the first view is a generic accordion, if a brief look commits, if the watched shutter stays exact, if the new segment is cosmetic, if every site folds the same way, if later edits reset, or if lifting is inexact.
